description: Create an attendance period (POST /v2/attendance-periods) — e.g. transfer an approved clockin workday. Required: person_id, type (WORK|BREAK), start (LOCAL time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, no time zone). Optional: end (local; max 24 h, no overlap, no crossing midnight — split at 00:00), comment, project_id (WORK only, project must be ACTIVE), skip_approval. Changes payroll-relevant time — needs approval.

skip_approval.description: Genehmigung in Personio überspringen (nur wenn die Zeit im Quellsystem, z. B. clockin, schon freigegeben ist)

name: create_personio_attendance
